title: QUIC Non-HTTP/3 Interop-Testcase Inventory Work Item
summary: Add a canonical inventory/profile slice that enumerates every documented non-HTTP/3 upstream QUIC testcase, classifies each case explicitly, and keeps per-cell artifact retention without claiming broad interop readiness.
planned_changes:
- Add a non-HTTP/3 inventory/profile slice to SPEC-QUIC-INT.
- Classify the documented upstream QUIC testcases into supported, intentionally unsupported, prerequisite-blocked, or not-mappable cells.
- Keep HTTP/3 out of scope.
- Preserve per-cell artifact retention and avoid generic unsupported fallthrough for the inventoried cases.
- Update the interop prep plan and gap ledger so the new goal is visible before code changes start.
out_of_scope: turning every inventory cell green immediately
verification_plan: Review the upstream QUIC testcase inventory from quic-interop-runner documentation, verify the new requirement and architecture classify each testcase explicitly, run any helper dry-run planning necessary to emit the inventory/profile, and finish with SpecTrace plus Workbench validation.
completion_notes: Helper inventory plumbing is complete for the inventory/profile slice. REQ-QUIC-INT-0018 now has direct requirement-home proof in tests/Incursa.Quic.Tests/RequirementHomes/INT/REQ-QUIC-INT-0018.cs. The documented non-HTTP/3 inventory is explicit in the helper and per-run artifacts, versionnegotiation, chacha20, keyupdate, resumption, zerortt, and connectionmigration are now green, while v2, rebind-port, and rebind-addr remain prerequisite-blocked. The chacha20 lane is closed by the local quic-go/quic-go runner proof under artifacts/interop-runner/20260513-011027614-both-quic-go/runner-report.json, and chacha20 now has runnable helper dispatch branches plus targeted unit and process coverage in tests/Incursa.Quic.Tests/InteropHarnessRunnerTests.cs and tests/Incursa.Quic.Tests/InteropHarnessProcessObservabilityTests.cs. Zerortt is also green under REQ-QUIC-INT-0021, with hosted run 25777328991 preserving packet-analysis evidence and the inventory classifier updated accordingly. Connectionmigration is green under REQ-QUIC-INT-0025, with hosted run 26174181713 preserving the completed-transfer, original/preferred path, migrated-path validation, and DCID-change evidence. The inventory/profile remains bounded to explicit classification and per-cell artifact retention rather than support-readiness claims.
